cases.expected: status CANCELLED; the invoice balance no longer counts towards customer.outstanding

cases.steps: POST /api/invoices/{id}/cancel twice
cases.expected: 400 "Invoice already cancelled"

cases.title: Server-side pagination on the invoice list: page 0 and page 1 are disjoint and add up
cases.steps: GET /api/invoices?customerId=..&size=10&page=0 then page=1, sorted by id asc
cases.expected: no id appears on both pages; totalElements equals the number of invoices for the customer; totalPages = ceil(total/size)

cases.title: Server-side sorting on pre-existing columns (total asc/desc, invoiceDate)
cases.steps: GET /api/invoices?customerId=..&sort=total,desc and sort=total,asc and sort=invoiceDate,desc
cases.expected: each result is ordered by the requested column; the two total orderings are reverses of one another
cases.actual: total desc ordered=true, total asc ordered=true, invoiceDate desc ordered=true, sort echo=total,desc

cases.title: Server-side filtering on pre-existing columns (status, customerId, total gte, invoiceNumber contains)
cases.steps: GET /api/invoices with filter=status:eq:CANCELLED, filter=total:gte:100, filter=invoiceNumber:contains:INV-
cases.expected: each filter narrows the set correctly and appliedFilters echoes it back
cases.actual: cancelled=1(all CANCELLED=true) total>=100 -> 2 rows (ok=true) numberContains -> 1 rows, applied=["status:eq:CANCELLED","customerId:eq:37"]

cases.title: Invoice summary tiles are computed server-side over the whole filtered set, not the page
cases.steps: GET /api/invoices/summary?customerId=..; compare with the full list read at size=50
cases.expected: count = totalElements; totalBilled = sum of every total (cancelled included, as before); totalPaid = sum of paidAmount; outstanding = sum of the live balances (cancelled counted as zero); per-status counts match the rows
cases.actual: tiles count=14/14 billed=233.81/233.81 paid=0/0.00 outstanding=131.81/131.81 statuses tiles=13/0/0/1 vs list=13/0/0/1

cases.title: Tiles follow the filter chips, not just the customer
cases.steps: GET /api/invoices/summary?customerId=..&filter=status:eq:CANCELLED
cases.expected: count = the cancelled count from the unfiltered tiles; cancelledCount = count
